title: Desk Tool Card — Signing Off a True-Up on an Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscription
content:
# Signing Off a True-Up

Desk tool card for the verification of a true-up period on a subscription under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions.

## What is signed off

At the tier's true-up the measured savings of the closing period are verified against the baseline standing on the subscription, and the figure signed off is what the guarantee is settled on. The verification is entered on the subscription's record for the period named, dated the day it is signed off, and the owner sees both the savings measured and the savings guaranteed on the true-up for that period.

The savings verified for a true-up period are worked out only after the baseline standing on the subscription has been restated from the close of the replacement or retrofit project at the building.

## The tool

`verify_period_savings_a6d7fa6e` is an agent-side tool: the client services agent unlocks it and calls it, entering the savings measured against the baseline and the savings guaranteed for that period. The same verification entered twice with the same details lands once.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `subscription_id` | the reference number of the energy monitoring subscription being verified, read from the subscription lookup for this building owner | Id |
| `customer_id` | the reference number of the building owner's account the verification belongs to, read from the account lookup | Id |
| `site_id` | the reference number of the building whose use was measured, read from the subscription record or the building lookup | Id |
| `billing_period` | the true-up period being verified | YYYY-MM for a monthly period, YYYY-Qn for a quarterly period, or YYYY for a whole subscription year; no other spelling is accepted and never left empty |
| `verified_savings_usd` | the savings measured against the baseline for the period | USD, 2 decimal places, positive, rounded half up to the cent |
| `guaranteed_savings_usd` | the savings guaranteed for the same period | USD, 2 decimal places, positive, rounded half up to the cent |
| `weather_normalized` | whether the comparison was weather normalised, one of exactly two values | `true` — the period's use and the baseline were adjusted for the weather before they were compared; `false` — they were compared as recorded, with no weather adjustment |

## Return

A confirmation sentence in plain text naming the subscription, the period verified, the savings measured in USD to two decimal places and the savings guaranteed in USD to two decimal places. Any sentence of that shape means the verification now stands on the subscription's record. No other return is defined.
